_comment: Template for scripts/run-agentic-evals.sh — do not run mcpjam against this file directly. NOOTICR_BASE_URL/NOOTICR_ACCESS_TOKEN are substituted at run time and written to environment.generated.json (gitignored), pointing at a throwaway nooticr-server booted in test mode (ALLOW_DEV_LOGIN=1 NOOTICR_E2E_MODE=1). Never a real account or a real deployment.
